reason: I already pay for a charter package that works well enough, and I've got years of quotes, customers and driver records in it. Free migration and a 60-day trial sound good, but I'm not swapping systems for a brand-new company with no customers, least of all in the middle of excursion and end-of-year season.
objection: Nobody is using it yet. If the migration goes wrong or it can't handle a messy multi-day charter quote, I'm the one sorting out double-bookings with a school while I'm short a driver. Who's even going to answer the phone when something breaks?
would_change_my_mind: Talking to two or three other small coach operators in NSW or VIC who've run a full busy season on it, plus a demo where it quotes one of my real charters and passes an accreditation audit check, with the switch done in the quiet months after summer.
